lee: Quick check-in on metering design. Two options: embed tiny fingerprint in serving responses or do full attribution later in billing pipeline. Thoughts?

noor: Fingerprint (8-12 chars) + small checkpoint ledger seems lowest friction. Keeps joins simple and limits raw-log retention.

pat: Agree but need to ensure tags can't be forged or leak PII. HMAC with tenant salt + short TTL in blob ledger.

lee: Operational sketch: runtime emits X-RW-TAG header; every 30s node writes a signed checkpoint blob (tag->req_id, model, route) to object store. Manifests by tenant-region per hour index blobs.

noor: Add 1% sampled full-trace in-line to validate enrichment and detect mapping bugs.

pat: SLOs: ledger write visible <30s, retention 90d, manifest lookup by tenant+window. Cost estimate tiny (~MBs/day).

ops-bot: @lee created task eng-platform#789 (ledger producer) assigned to noor, due in 2 weeks.

lee: OK I'll draft RFC follow-up with schema and security plan.
